test_load_game: test loading a universal_poker game via pyspiel.load_game and verifying the initial state is not terminal
test_state_struct: test creating a configured universal_poker game and inspecting state_struct fields like blinds, pot_size, player_hands, and odds
test_random_game: test running random gameplay loops with chance outcomes and legal actions until terminal states are reached
test_pickle: test serializing and deserializing a universal_poker game state with pickle and verifying string equality
test_register_check: test checking if universal_poker is registered in pyspiel before running tests via registered_names
